payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to address data sparsity in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, including data augmentation techniques and the use of BPE.

claims.text: Advanced methods were combined to reduce the adverse impacts of data sparsity in NMT systems.
Data augmentation methods, such as the mix-source method, were considered useful in low-resourced settings to alleviate data sparsity.
BPE (Byte Pair Encoding) was used as a data compression technique to help manage data sparsity.
Methods were chosen to alleviate the data sparsity problem in low-resourced settings when applied.
